# Right Ankle Atlas
Explore a 3D model of the right ankle and foot. Rotate the model, adjust the ankle pose, and see how bones, ligaments and tendons move together. The anatomy is a simplified teaching model.
    
Run `node server.mjs` with Node 20 or later and open http://localhost:4173. Run `node tests/verify.mjs` to check the joint motion and tissue attachments. Three.js is included with its license in `dist/vendor`.
